questions.q: Butanone is treated with Mg/Hg and the product is hydrolysed with water. The major organic product is:
questions.explain: Two butanone molecules couple head-to-head at their carbonyl carbons, giving C₂H₅(CH₃)C(OH)–C(OH)(CH₃)C₂H₅. 2,3-Dimethylbutane-2,3-diol is the pinacol from acetone, not butanone.

questions.q: Which statement about pinacol coupling with Mg/Hg is NOT correct?
options: A new C–C bond forms between the two carbonyl carbons
The carbonyl group is reduced to a CH₂ group
Water is needed to convert the magnesium diolate into the diol
questions.explain: Each C=O becomes a C–OH on adjacent carbons; reduction of C=O to CH₂ is the Clemmensen reduction with Zn/Hg and HCl, a common trap.

questions.q: Acetone is treated with (i) Mg/Hg, (ii) H₂O to give A, and A is then heated with H⁺ to give B. B is:
questions.explain: A is pinacol, (CH₃)₂C(OH)–C(OH)(CH₃)₂; acid and heat cause the pinacol–pinacolone rearrangement to (CH₃)₃C–CO–CH₃, pinacolone.

questions.q: Two carbonyl compounds are reductively coupled. Which statement is correct?
options: Stoichiometric low-valent titanium removes both oxygens and gives an alkene
Aliphatic ketones generally give higher yields than aryl ketones
Mixing two different ketones gives a single cross-coupled diol
Butanone gives a single stereoisomer of its diol
questions.explain: With stoichiometric low-valent titanium the diol oxygens are removed and an alkene forms (McMurry reaction). Aryl ketones couple better, mixed ketones give mixtures, and butanone gives meso and racemic diastereomers.
